integrity: All connected unlabeled Graph Atlas representatives through seven vertices are checked. Eigenvector-coordinate comparisons use exact characteristic polynomials, rational Sturm root isolation, and principal cofactors rather than floating-point eigensolvers. All five first-conflict automorphism groups and labeled orbits are replayed directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected finite simple undirected graphs, unweighted adjacency eigenvector centrality, and cases in which both degree and eigenvector centrality have unique maximizers. The exhaustive classification ends at seven vertices.
title: Seven vertices are the sharp unique-leader split for degree and eigenvector centrality
